**Discover Tirol with MyWay** **Your personal travel guide to the heart of the Alps** **MyWay in Tirol** is your all-in-one travel companion for unforgettable adventures in the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Whether you're exploring the charming old towns, hiking through breathtaking alpine meadows, or indulging in hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or **Schlutzkrapfen**, we’ve got you covered. **Plan your trip effortlessly** With **MyWay**, you can create your perfect itinerary—from the vibrant city life of **Innsbruck** to the serene beauty of **Ötztal** or the fairy-tale villages of **Lienz**. Our interactive maps, real-time updates, and insider tips make every step of your journey seamless. **Experience Tirol like a local** Dive into authentic **Tiroler** culture with hidden gems, traditional festivals, and cozy mountain huts (**Hütten**). Whether you're skiing in **St. Anton am Arlberg**, cycling through the **Lech Valley**, or savoring a glass of **Grauburgunder** in **Meran**, **MyWay** connects you to the best of the region. **Flexible, smart, and always at your side** Download the app or use the web version—your digital travel assistant is always with you. Need last-minute recommendations? Want to book a table at a top-rated **Gasthof**? **MyWay** makes it easy. **Start your adventure today** **Tirol** awaits—explore, discover, and fall in love with the Alps. **MyWay in Tirol** is your key to an unforgettable journey. --- **

Highlights

** **
** **

Innsbruck – The Alpine Capital

** Dive into **Tirol’s** most dynamic city, where golden-roofed palaces meet modern flair. Stroll through the **Altstadt**, visit the **Goldenes Dachl**, and enjoy a **Tiroler Gröstl** with a view of the **Nordkette**. **

Ötztal – Wild and Untouched

** A paradise for nature lovers, **Ötztal** offers pristine glaciers, rugged peaks, and the legendary **Ötzi**, Europe’s oldest mummy. Hike to **Hochzeiger**, or relax in the thermal spas of **Längenfeld**. **

Lienz – Charm of the Eastern Alps

** Step into a storybook setting with **Lienz’s** medieval old town, the **Puster Valley**, and the dramatic **Drau River**. Don’t miss the **Kaiserschmarrn** at **Gasthof Goldener Adler**! **

St. Anton am Arlberg – Skiing & Panache

** The ultimate winter playground, **St. Anton** blends world-class skiing with **Tiroler** hospitality. After a day on the slopes, warm up with **Käsespätzle** and a local **Schnaps**. **

Meran – The Sunny Pearl

** **Meran** is pure relaxation—sun-drenched orchards, elegant promenades, and world-class thermal baths. Pair your visit with a glass of **Grauburgunder** and a slice of **Meraner Apfelstrudel**. **

Lech Valley – Cycling & Scenery

** Pedal through one of Europe’s most beautiful cycling routes, from **Füssen** to **Hintersteinbach**, with stops at lakes, castles, and cozy **Biergärten**. **

Zillertal – Adventure & Tradition

** From the thrilling **Zillertal Arena** to the tranquil **Ziller Valley**, this region offers everything—hiking, rafting, and **Tiroler** craftsmanship. Try **Schlutzkrapfen** at a mountain hut for the ultimate alpine experience. **

Kitzbühel – Elegance & Alpine Flair

** A jewel of **Tirol**, **Kitzbühel** charms with its historic town center, the **Hahnenkamm** downhill race, and gourmet **Tiroler** cuisine. Don’t leave without tasting **Topfenknödel**! **

Hallstatt – The Postcard Village

** A UNESCO-listed fairy tale, **Hallstatt** mesmerizes with its lake, salt mines, and sky-kissing church. Savor **Hallstätter Krapfen** and soak in the breathtaking views. **

Imst – Gateway to the Alps

** The vibrant heart of **Tirol**, **Imst** connects you to the **Karwendel** and **Lechtal**. Explore the **Museum of the Alps**, then enjoy a **Tiroler Apfelkuchen** at a local café. --- **

Ready to explore?
